spec: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).
module_header:
module top_module(
	input clk,
	input reset,
	input [31:0] in,
	output reg [31:0] out);
